item.tib: kun bzang thugs kyi yang thig rgyud las me drod bde ba'i 'od 'bar
item.coloph: ces me drod bde ba'i 'od 'bar 'di/ gsang bdag mkha' 'gro dbyings phyug gis/ snyigs ma'i kho bo byang chub rtsal gyi snyan du brgyud/ phyi rabs 'gro la phan phyir gnas mchog shel brag rdzong du bkod pa sa ma ya//
